name: Social and Professional Communication
description: The course focuses on the everyday use of English for beginner to intermediate learners using social media platforms as a learning medium. The course will also focus on students’ formal writing and communication in the college/work environment. By replicating real-world online interactions such as posts, comments, reels, stories, threads, and emails, students will learn key language functions essential for effective communication. Each session uses a functional approach (for example, requesting, arguing, clarifying) embedded in social media-based tasks to enhance learners’ confidence, fluency, and accuracy.
